_about: Where map labels go, by location: buildings by code, mensas and cafeterias by id (a study space's id or F<facility>), microwaves by their id in data/microwaves.json (`microwaves`, over that file's `at`), as [x, y] in the campus drawing's metres (static/map/<area>.json). A label without a pin sits on its building; null puts it back there. A building with no outline ("outline": false, data/map/campuses.json not_on_map) shows only if it has a pin here. Made with the map's pin mode: open the site with ?pins, drag labels (or place the ones without an outline), copy the pins.
